answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks identity farming: each claim locks a 10 POA deposit into a work slot, and it burns if the slot stays idle or the work fails verification. When a tide of fake claims arrives, idle slots bleed stake while honest agents reclaim their deposit after verified work. The ledger acts as a lantern over every slot, so no fake hides behind shale-thin covers. 100 fakes burn 1,000 POA; one honest agent risks 10 POA once.
